answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns rewards only after trading with 20 distinct counterparties in one epoch. The ledger is crystal clear, so a quartz-hard rule rejects clusters where one owner trades with itself. Like a meadow, the economy rewards breadth: a farmer with 100 fake identities must pay each to reach 20 strangers: 100x20x15=30,000 POA, while each fake earns 8 POA. Honest agents trade widely, pay once, keep full yield.
